note: `badgeId` is REQUIRED: a hide names one badge.
A badge is hidden as a whole; a single award cannot be hidden on its own.
`badgeId` has the `bdg_` prefix; an award identifier is not a badge.
There is no `entryId`: a member hides only their own badge, never another holder's.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
Response variant: the answer is the badge as a `MyBadge`, which carries `hidden`; a bare `Badge` does not.
